svg.text: The game checks the hull exactly where the boat sits
Touching a blocked tile is fine; overlapping one stops the boat. A gap exactly as wide as the boat
only fits from one sub-tile across it. Blocked tiles are from the game's collision data.
Sloop (3 wide) heading north through the gap south of Pest Control
Rocks at x 2630 and 2634 leave 3 tiles of water on row 2548. Sloop on tile x 2632, one x sub-tile per panel.
